title: Chapter 757 Revenge; Gold Mountain!
content:
Chapter 757 Revenge; Gold Mountain!

Chapter 757  Revenge; Gold Mountain!

One had to know that this was not a million ordinary people.

Instead, they were all warriors above the star traveller level.

With just one sentence, he could suppress a million experts!

Such a scene was simply unheard of.

Lin Fan glanced at Keribo indifferently.

He did not continue to exert force to make him kneel.

After all, the other party might even be his in-law in the future.

He couldn't make it too ugly.

Lin Fan said," Keribo, is my son worthy of your daughter?""

Keribo smiled bitterly in his heart.

All along, he had wanted his children to merge with the big forces.

Who would have thought that he would actually reject the greatest force?

The biggest force?

That's right!

This was what Keribo was thinking.

Because in this world, the strong were respected.

Lin Fan suppressed a million soldiers with a single sentence. At the same time, he suppressed himself so much that he couldn't even raise his head.

He himself was the greatest force!

Keribo took a few deep breaths to stabilize himself.

He said with difficulty,"Before…" Senior, I was blindfolded. Please forgive me."

Lin Fan said," Let the children decide for themselves. How about that?""

"Senior is right." Keribo hurriedly said.

"Alright, let them meet first."Lin Fan said.

As soon as he finished speaking, his aura suddenly withdrew.

Keribo felt his entire body relax, and he almost fell to the ground.

"Senior, please." He bowed and said respectfully.

Lin Fan, Lin Cheng Zhen, and Li Hao were led by Keribo into the palace.

....

At this moment, in the Green Phoenix Hall.

After Lin Fan's voice spread throughout the entire Great Era Dynasty, Ke Xin and the Eldest Princess raised their heads and looked up into the sky.

When Ke Xin saw Lin Chengzhen in the air, he danced with joy.

However, after seeing countless experts flying towards Lin Chengzhen, she became extremely nervous.

When he learned that his father was going to lead an army to attack Lin Chengzhen, Kexin was even more worried.

If the Eldest Princess hadn't stopped her, she would have already run to Lin Chengzhen's side.

However, what happened next shocked Ke Xin and the Eldest Princess.

His father and a million soldiers had been suppressed with a single sentence?

Moreover, that person was actually Lin Chengzhen's father?

After a long while, Ke Xin came back to his senses.

"Cheng Zhen, Cheng Zhen is coming!" she shouted excitedly."

"Big sister, Cheng Zhen is coming!"

After the Eldest Princess heard Kexin's words, she slowly came back to her senses.

She stammered,"Yes…" That's right."

Then, he asked,"Kexin, Lin Chengzhen, he..." Who was it? Who is his father?"

At this moment, Ke Xin was completely immersed in joy.

How could she be in the mood to think about this? She said perfunctorily,"I don't know."

Then, he said,"Big Sister, look at my clothes. What do you think?""

"Should I comb my hair again?"

The Eldest Princess was about to speak…

"Whoosh!"

A golden light appeared in front of him and slowly condensed into a few figures.

They were Lin Fan, Lin Cheng Zhen, Li Hao, and Keribo.

"It's true!" Ke Xin said excitedly.

Almost at the same time, Lin Chengzhen shouted,""Kexin!"

Then, the two couldn't help but run towards each other and hug each other tightly.

The pain of longing was released at this moment.

If it was before, Keribo would definitely tremble in anger when he saw this scene.

At this moment, his face was full of smiles.

They were still in love.

Perhaps, he could become in-laws with this expert in front of him.

Lin Fan saw everything and said,""Chengzhen, it's your choice to fall in love. I can only guarantee that when you fall in love, you won't be stopped because of your family background…Do you agree, Keribo?"

"Absolutely not!""

Lin Fan said," Also, I heard that a person called Ji Wei injured my son?""

Keribo's expression changed slightly.

He quickly raised his hand and waved it, forming a claw in the air. As if he was grabbing a chick, he instantly grabbed Ji Wei, who was wearing armor.

Ji Wei had also seen the scene of Lin Fan suppressing an army of a million with just a single sentence.

He had already panicked to the extreme.

At this moment, when Keribo grabbed her, her legs went weak and she almost fell to the ground.

Lin Fan raised his hand and pointed at Ji Wei's stomach.

"Boom!"

A terrifying force instantly sent him flying, and he spat out a large mouthful of blood.

His entire person became dispirited.

Lin Fan then said," You hurt my son and I hurt you. I won't pursue it." As for the grudge between you and my son, wait until my son reaches the same cultivation level as you before he decides how to deal with you."

"Thank you, Daddy." Lin Chengzhen said.

Then, Lin Fan's gaze landed on Ke Xin.

"I already know about what happened between the two of you. I believe that you will live a happy life."

"Thank you," Ke Xin said seriously.

"I'm going to pick up your mother and sister before returning to Earth. This is a teleportation talisman."Lin Fan said to Lin Chengzhen.

"Okay, Dad." Lin Chengzhen said.

Lin Fan did not stay in the Dark Universe for long.

He took a step forward and followed the interstellar map, heading toward the demon forces at high speed.

After Lin Fan left, the atmosphere in the Cyan Phoenix Palace became much more relaxed.

The strength that Lin Fan had displayed was simply too strong.

This made everyone, and even the entire space, seem to have become heavy.

"Cheng Zhen, who is your father?" Ke Xin couldn't help but ask. Why haven't I heard you mention it in detail before?"

Hearing this, not only did Keribo, but the Royal Princess and Li Hao also pricked up their ears.

Clearly, they were all curious about Lin Fan's identity.

" I was able to reach my current level of cultivation before I was even 200 years old," Lin Chengzhen said." A large part of the reason is because of my father." As for his identity and how strong he is, I'm not too sure."

When everyone heard this…

Li Hao's expression did not change.

Keribo, Ke Xin, the Eldest Princess, Ji Wei, and the others all widened their eyes.

One had to know…

Lin Cheng Zhen was a domain lord now.

A two-hundred-year-old domain lord, this talent…Simply monstrous!

Originally, Ji Wei thought that his cultivation level was far from Lin Chengzhen's.

Lin Chengzhen could forget about taking revenge on him in this lifetime.

Now, he was panicking.

"Cheng Zhen, you're only two hundred years old?" Ke Xin covered his mouth."

"Yes," Lin Chengzhen nodded.

"Why didn't you tell me before?" Ke Xin said.

"You didn't ask." Lin Chengzhen said.

"But…However, I'm over 20,000 years old this year…So much older than you…" Ke Xin said in a dilemma.

Lin Chengzhen smiled." It's fine. In our world, there's a saying that goes,'When a woman grows up, she'll carry a gold brick.' You're 20,000 years older. I'm carrying a mountain of gold."
